name: open42
description: Self-hostable Company Brain on top of gbrain.

scripts.docs:install: python3 -m venv .venv-docs && .venv-docs/bin/python -m pip install -U pip && .venv-docs/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements-docs.txt
scripts.dokku:build: test -n "$OPEN42_DOKKU_WORKSPACE" && if [ "$OPEN42_DOKKU_WORKSPACE" = "@open42/api" ] && [ "$OPEN42_EDITION" = "cloud" ]; then npm ci --prefix packages/cloud/api --ignore-scripts && npm run build -w "$OPEN42_DOKKU_WORKSPACE" && npm run build:cloud-api; else npm run build -w "$OPEN42_DOKKU_WORKSPACE"; fi
scripts.dokku:start: if [ "$OPEN42_DOKKU_WORKSPACE" = "@open42/api" ]; then if [ "$OPEN42_EDITION" = "cloud" ]; then npm run db:migrate:cloud -w @open42/api; else npm run db:migrate -w @open42/api; fi; fi; npm run start -w "$OPEN42_DOKKU_WORKSPACE"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @open42/landing && npm run build -w @open42/web && npm run build -w @open42/api && npm run build:mobile
scripts.build:cloud: OPEN42_EDITION=cloud npm run build -w @open42/landing && OPEN42_EDITION=cloud npm run build -w @open42/web && OPEN42_EDITION=cloud npm run build -w @open42/api && OPEN42_EDITION=cloud npm run build:cloud-api && npm run build:mobile
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @open42/landing && npm run lint -w @open42/web && npm run lint -w @open42/api && npm run lint -w @open42/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @open42/landing && npm run typecheck -w @open42/web && npm run typecheck -w @open42/api && npm run typecheck -w @open42/mobile
scripts.typecheck:cloud: OPEN42_EDITION=cloud npm run typecheck -w @open42/landing && OPEN42_EDITION=cloud npm run typecheck:cloud -w @open42/web && OPEN42_EDITION=cloud npm run typecheck:cloud -w @open42/api && OPEN42_EDITION=cloud npm run typecheck:cloud-api && npm run typecheck -w @open42/mobile
scripts.test: npm run test -w @open42/api && npm run test -w @open42/web && npm run test -w @open42/mobile
scripts.eval:chat:test: vitest run evals/chat/grader.test.ts && npm run eval:chat:self-test
